text:
alex: Kickoff: ISV/tooling integrations bootcamp next week. Goal is a conformance dry-run + SI QA handoff. Need volunteers for test harness, marketplace packaging, and HW validation. High-level agenda: sandbox sign-on, adapter shim smoke tests, orchestrator e2e, and joint announcement checklist. Who can own which?

sara_pm: I can own the marketplace + announcement checklist. Planning to draft a PRD by EOD Thu. Need asset list from eng. :memo:

jia_eng: I can take the adapter shim + smoke tests. Can we scope a minimal test matrix (langchain + llamaindex + gateway shim + orch)?

mike_partnerships: I'll coordinate SI invites and run the partner comms. Quick ask: which SIs need private packaging vs cloud-marketplace listing?

alex: Good. Minimal test matrix: 1) basic forward pass (text gen) 2) tool-calling + function outputs 3) embeddings + retrieval via LlamaIndex adaptor 4) orchestration retry/fallback. Keep each test under 30s to fit the sandbox.

elena_sre: On infra: need a dedicated sandbox cluster for the bootcamp. I'll request 2 g4dn + 1 cpu-only coordinator for the harness. Also need logs/trace link and a short retention policy for debug artifacts.

jia_eng: For the shim tests I'll add these commands to the harness. Quick example we can run locally against the sandbox:

```bash
export API_KEY=TEST_KEY
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.internal/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rlm-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize this repo"}]}'
```

jia_eng: And a retrieval smoke:

```python
from redwood import Client
c = Client(api_key="$TEST")
resp = c.embeddings.create(model="embed-lite", input=["q1","q2"])
print(resp.data)
```

mike_partnerships: For SI packaging: some will want a marketplace-listed bundle (cloud images + helm). Others will need an on-prem tarball + doc-runbook. I'll split the invite list into two tracks.

alex: Nice. Assignments so far: marketplace & announcement -> @sara_pm, shim + harness -> @jia_eng, infra + logs -> @elena_sre, partner invites -> @mike_partnerships. I can own the orchestration e2e and the joint release gating.

elena_sre: FYI deploy-bot flagged a quota on the test cluster last week. I'll pre-clear quotas and add a small blackout window in the schedule so partners don't overlap tests.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: WARNING: upcoming maintenance window 1711112600-1711113300. Please ack if this affects dry-run.

sara_pm: acked. We'll keep the bootcamp outside that Maintenance window. Proposed slot: 1711114000 (next Tue 2pm PT) — aligns with most EMEA partners in mornings.

jia_eng: Timeline for tech deliverables: shim + harness first cut by Mon EOD, unit smoke tests by Wed, e2e orchestration by Fri. Can the infra crew greenlight the sandbox by Mon morning?

elena_sre: I'll approve the cluster by Mon 09:00 PT if we have the CI manifests and the test user accounts. Send the list of test accounts and any temporary IAM roles.

mike_partnerships: I'll prepare partner invites with two tracks and a simple RSVP form: track selection, telemetry opt-in, contact for legal. Also will request logos and partner one-liners by Fri.

alex: Ops checklist for the bootcamp (short):
- create sandbox cluster + quotas (elena)
- share test harness repo and instructions (jia)
- marketplace assets + PRD (sara)
- partner invites + RSVP (mike)
- release gating doc + fallback policy (alex)

alex: One more ask — can someone make a tiny runbook for common failures (model mismatch, shim 401, KV cache issues)? 2 short commands to triage.

jia_eng: I can draft that. Sample triage: `curl /v1/status` to check model mapping, `curl /v1/debug/kv` to check KV cache.

sara_pm: I'll draft the announcement blurb and the checklist for joint-announce approvals (marketing, legal, partner signoff).

elena_sre: Quick logistics note: HW partners asked for a short validation plan for GPU images (driver + cuDNN). Can we include a compatibility column in the test matrix?

alex: Yes please add GPU validator to the matrix. We should mark which images are required for Marketplace vs On-prem bundles.

mike_partnerships: Ok I'll collect hardware partner images and add them to the RSVP so SIs indicate which HW they can test on.

alex: Thanks all. Next sync: Mon 10am PT for a quick readiness check (15m). If you hit blockers call out in this thread.

mike_partnerships: 👍 I'll seed the RSVP and partner list after this meeting.

sara_pm: added action items in the doc, link: https://docs.internal/redwood/bootcamp/integration-bootcamp (private).

jia_eng: starting the harness PR now -> will ping when CI passes.

elena_sre: pre-cleared quotas and created skeleton cluster. Will add credentials to the test vault after PR lands.

alex: Perfect. See you on Mon. :rocket:
